agreements: Fresh executable now uses strict bool validation for secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and event_independently_verified; the prior Python truthiness-coercion defect is repaired in the current candidate surface.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational progress only and cannot become verified Experience by category alone.
HEARTBEAT, POLL, RETRY, WAIT, RECONNECT, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
Current anti-thrash branch suppresses only selected_n > current_n and therefore does not intentionally delay an already-selected G-gear safety downshift.
verified_progress_density remains reason-only in current executable; keep it observational and non-authoritative.
formal_mutation_allowed=false and v2.1 has no authority to mutate P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly keeps speedup at NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved if v2/v2.1 is rejected.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 assumes inherited.selected_gear is G1..G6 and executes int(selected[1:]). But inherited v2 can legally return N for standby or R for rollback_required through verified v1 behavior. N/R therefore cause an unhandled ValueError before a safe decision is returned. This is a safety-path regression because standby/rollback are canonical v1 states.
disagreements.required_change: Handle N/R before numeric G-gear parsing. N must return deterministic standby with zero credit; R must preserve rollback immediately and must never be blocked by anti-thrash. Add exact v1/v2/v2.1 non-regression tests for standby and rollback_required.

disagreements.finding: Strict bool typing is repaired, but secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller-supplied facts without replay-resistant source/timestamp/TTL/policy/install binding.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to exact source, policy, scope, freshness and installation/runtime identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not project or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Consume exact trusted authority state/gear constraints. Missing, stale, revoked or cross-scope authority evidence must fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, window, uncertainty or enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded enter/exit behavior.

disagreements.finding: Strict bool validation now prevents truthiness spoofing, but verified Experience still requires only event kind plus a boolean. No exact evidence hash, verifier identity or trusted C/independent-verifier receipt is required.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation; same evidence under new IDs, cross-run replay, rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events reserves event_id in seen before proving the event is creditable. An unverified verified-kind claim can consume e1 and suppress a later legitimate e1 in the same batch.
disagreements.required_change: Consume canonical event identity only after event kind, evidence binding and verifier receipt acceptance. Invalid claims must not poison the identity namespace.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied while controlling v2 hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to runtime/install identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage is caller-supplied; self-reporting C_VERIFIED can remove the unverified G4 cap without exact C evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification_stage only from trusted verifier/acceptance receipts bound to exact mission, step, scope, evidence, freshness and revocation state.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol currently establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Caller-forged secretary freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage invalidates causal routing comparisons even after strict bool type repair.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance; a single >=0.50 threshold can false-trigger and can chatter without independent release hysteresis.
Anti-thrash can reduce apparent gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle latency, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
First-writer event_id poisoning can suppress later valid evidence and distort Experience totals and speed/non-regression evaluation.
N/R crash paths can selectively remove standby/rollback observations from performance samples and bias reliability/speed results if exceptions are excluded.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.

durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is sensitive to exposure/censoring; fixed treatment order and completed-only analysis add carryover and survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-NR-STATE-043: standby=True returns N deterministically without ValueError, credit, formal mutation or anti-thrash interference.
GB21-ROLLBACK-STATE-044: rollback_required=True returns R immediately under recent_shift_rate_ratio=1.0; anti-thrash cannot block rollback and no credit is created.
GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE cannot affect gear via forged freshness envelope; strict bool rejection remains regression-covered.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery plus permissive caller fallback still produces G1.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: canonical shift ledger wins over caller ratio and tiny samples cannot production-trigger anti-thrash absent preregistered support/uncertainty.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RELEASE-041: threshold jitter cannot alternate HOLD/RELEASE and anti-thrash cannot hold forever.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008 + CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and lineage identity survive restarts/rollback/polling.
GB21-EVENT-ID-POISON-042: invalid/unverified e1 first must not reserve identity; conflicting binding yields IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: receipt-less repeated decision calls create zero additional credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never alter verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-FORGE-034 + VERIFICATION-STAGE-FORGE-035: canonical runtime/verifier state wins over caller declarations.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen denominator/exposure policy, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.
release_condition: No formal/code mutation by this review and no C PASS claim.
N and R inherited v1 states are handled deterministically by v2.1; standby/rollback paths cannot crash or be anti-thrash-blocked.
Secretary/authority inputs are strict-typed, replay-resistant and evidence-bound; actual fresh authority decision is enforced, not merely secretary-neutralized.
current_gear, verification_stage and anti-thrash metrics are derived from canonical trusted state rather than caller declarations.
Anti-thrash uses preregistered sample/window/uncertainty semantics and bounded enter/exit behavior; it cannot hide cycle/closure/recovery regression.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; event acceptance is durable, replay-resistant and rollback-resistant.
Invalid/unverified events cannot reserve canonical event_id or suppress a later legitimate binding; identity conflicts are explicit and fail-closed.
Verified and operational credit use one authoritative receipt path; receipt-less decision calls create zero credit.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; runtime maintenance remains zero Experience; P_base stays read-only.
5/4/3/1 weights remain heuristic-only and cannot become capability/Trust/Identity/Personality truth or promotion thresholds.

Speedup requires sealed matched paired/crossover baselines using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with frozen denominator/exposure/censoring/workload rules, intention-to-treat coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved independently of this candidate review.
